node.statement: The arbitrary algebra is finite-dimensional and exact-unit, delta>0, and 1.2-1.3 are exactly the two scalar hypotheses of lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws for its witnesses A,B,k. Therefore that external lemma applies and yields its polar inverse u_delta, the formulas mu(U,V)=u_delta(U bold-dot V), sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger), their asserted all-domain C^1 regularity, all three exact identities, and its five estimates with constant A.
